pattern_note: Real pattern = a modern .308-class bolt-action rifle in a one-piece aluminium chassis (short-action, 3-lug 60 deg bolt, detachable double-stack box, chassis-type fixed butt with an adjustable riser, tension-swivel folding bipod on a forend dovetail). Generic: no maker's part is copied; shapes follow the sheet, construction follows how such parts are made. No names of real products appear in any shipped text.

scale.frame: M: +X muzzle, +Z up, +Y gun left; X 0 butt-pad rear, Z 0 bore
scale.accuracy: sheet 1 px = 1.88 mm; silhouette edges +-0.8 mm, hand seams +-1.9 mm

panels.GR: sheet 'LEFT' = the gun's RIGHT side (bolt handle, knob); muzzle image-right
panels.GL: sheet 'RIGHT' = the gun's LEFT side; muzzle image-left (mirrored for tracing)
panels.TOP: muzzle image-right, gun right image-down (knob protrudes down)

parts.name: chassis
parts.bevel: outer edges 0.6 mm 45 deg chamfer (>= rear visibility minimum 0.4); inside pocket corners keep the cutter radius 3.0 mm; slot edges 0.4
parts.texel: B (X < 450: comb, action bed, grip top), C (forend, mag well)
parts.construction: One-piece machined chassis from the butt interface (X 150 px ~ X 244) to the forend front (X 836.8): action bed with a full-length bolt raceway (radius 12.5 at Z 0, open on top between X 345 and 567), an inletted receiver pocket, integral mag well (walls 3.0, clearance 0.3 to the mag, catch window at the rear, top shelf at Z -11.5), trigger-housing pocket, integral guard bosses, and the forend tube (U-section, wall 3.5) free-floating around the barrel with >= 3.0 radial clearance. The drawn panel recess on the action side (X ~455-560, both sides) is a 0.8 mm deep pocket with 3 mm corner radius. Three slots per side (X 662-698, 715-752, 768-811; Z -12.9..-3.5) cut through the forend wall with 0.4 chamfers; these are an original slot pattern (never named after a trade standard). Bottom of the forend: an integral plain dovetail band X 582-831 (the drawn lower band), 38 mm across, 45 deg flanks, no slots (none drawn).
key_features: bolt raceway is real geometry: the bolt slides 88 mm back in it
mag well walls, shelf and catch window modelled (form stage)
no seam drawn between centre and forend: one part
action-bed screw heads only where drawn

parts.name: butt
parts.bevel: 0.6 chamfer outer; 2.5 radius at the cut-out's inside corners
parts.construction: Fixed skeleton-style butt bolted to the chassis at X ~244 (a 0.3 mm visible seam with depth 0.5, the only joint drawn). Profile = the traced 'butt' part: flat top Z -16.7 (riser seat), lower edge rising from the heel step to the grip, rear vertical slab X 57-100 px with a stepped lower heel. The two drawn round heads (X 99 / 129, Z -67.5, dia 15) are the length-of-pull/ butt-height clamp knobs (knurled cap, 2 mm proud). Riser post bores (2x dia 10) in the top face.
key_features: hinge not drawn: fixed (R6)
heel step as drawn
two clamp knobs on the right only (GL draws a rectangular QD-cup recess at X ~110-135 instead)

parts.name: pad_plate
parts.construction: LOP spacer plate X 52.9-68.9 between the butt and the pad, three socket-head screws (dia 6 / 8.3 / 6 drawn heads at Z -26, -69, -103) on the right; real pattern: 4 mm thread socket caps in counterbores.
key_features: screw heads from the sheet (>= 4 px for the middle one)

parts.name: butt_pad
parts.bevel: R 3.0-4.0 on the outer edges, R 1.5 on the face ribs
parts.construction: Thick recoil pad X 0-52.9, Z -153.7..16.4 (170 tall), width 61 (TOP left half x 2), rounded rectangle section; three horizontal moulded grooves on the side faces as drawn (0.8 deep); rear face flat with a faint stipple (normal only); slight draft 1.5 deg.
key_features: rubber never shows metal
toe and heel abraded (R)

parts.name: cheek_riser
parts.process_class: M-chamfer (machined aluminium plate on two steel posts)
parts.bevel: 0.6 chamfer; plate's lower front corner chamfer 6 x 45 as drawn
parts.construction: Plate X 68.9-179.9, top Z 32.0, bottom Z -3.5 (35.5 thick), width 69 (TOP); a shallow cheek dish 1.5 mm on its left top (unseen, real pattern; plain if Q-free). Two posts dia 10 at X ~95 and ~150 into bores in the butt's top (sliding clearance 0.15-0.40); a clamp lever on the left side of the butt (GL draws a small dark lever at X ~95, Z -10). Height: sheet pose = rest; travel -12.9..+12.0 mm (plate bottom 0.3 above the butt top at the low stop).
key_features: exposed post length at rest 13.2 mm (drawn)
cheek-weld wear on the left top (G)

parts.name: receiver
parts.construction: Round receiver dia 34.3 (real short-action class), X 382-567, axis = bore; ejection port on the right X 422.5-507.1, Z 4.9-14.3 (drawn) opened to the real port shape (cut to the bolt raceway, wall 3.0 visible); bolt-handle notch at the rear bridge right (the handle root drops into it when closed: 60 deg cam slope); recoil lug ring at the front under the chassis; the integral scope base rail screwed on top (separate part 'rail').
key_features: port interior and bolt face revealed when open
rear tang on the right carries the safety
bolt stop on the left rear, hidden in the chassis (not animated, R11)

parts.name: rail
parts.construction: Scope base X 385.8-546.6 (160.8), top Z 30.0, built by gunlib rail_1913 with 15 slots at 10.01 centred (end webs ~5.4); flat (0 MOA: the drawn scope axis is parallel to the bore within 0.06 deg); 4 button-head screws in slots 1, 5, 9, 13 (dia 4.8 heads inside the 5.24 slots, SMG C13 lesson).
key_features: drawn tooth pitch 10.6 mm: built at 10.01 (line standard)
Rail_Top = centre of slot 0

parts.name: bolt
parts.bevel: 0.3 on lugs, 0.8 round on the shroud's rear edge
parts.construction: Bolt body dia 17.8 from the face X 505 back to the shroud; three locking lugs at 120 deg (OD 25.4, 12 long) at the front: they ride in the raceway's lug grooves and lock into the receiver ring's lug recesses (modelled: 3 recesses cut 60 deg wide); recessed bolt face with an extractor hook (right) and plunger ejector hole; shroud X 345.4-380 (drawn: dia ~24, rear dome); cocking indicator tip at the shroud rear (plain). Real pattern: 3-lug 60 deg throw.
key_features: rotate 60 deg, then slide 88 mm (clip BoltCycle)
polished sliding flanks (R forced)
bolt face visible through the open port

parts.name: bolt_handle
parts.bevel: stem 0.8 round; knob is a revolve
parts.construction: Stem from the bolt's rear right at X ~383, swept 15 mm rearward and 26 deg below horizontal to the knob centre (X 367.9, Y -66.5, Z -33.6); knob dia 24.8 (sheet), a sphere with a 6 mm flat at the stem joint; 0.4 thread-relief groove at the joint (knob screws on, real pattern). Y of the knob from TOP (right edge -85.0 less the 5 mm shadow bias, less the radius).
key_features: TOP draws the knob 32 mm further back than GR: GR wins X, TOP gives Y
clears the scope by >= 20 mm open and back (S0 check)

parts.name: safety
parts.construction: Two-position rocker on the right receiver tang behind the bolt handle (real 2-position tang pattern): lever 14 long x 5 wide x 4 thick, serrated thumb face (geometry: 4 ridges at 1.2 pitch), pivot at X 360.0, Z -16.0 on a transverse pin; FIRE = forward (bind), SAFE = 12 deg rearward. Not resolved on the sheet (< 3 px): size and place from the real pattern (G6 source = norm).
key_features: only on the right (G10)
thumb-travel scratch arc (G)

parts.name: trigger
parts.construction: Curved blade X 348.2-385.8 (traced), face X 363.2 at mid height; pivot inside the trigger housing above the blade at X 368, Z -57; pull 0..+6 deg (lower end rearward; 3 mm at the finger, precision trigger). Housing and adjustment screws hidden in the chassis pocket (not modelled beyond the pocket walls).
key_features: LOP 363 mm (14.3 in) to the face
face polish (G)

parts.name: trigger_guard
parts.process_class: M-chamfer (machined aluminium, part of the chassis bottom)
parts.construction: Integral guard loop, opening 54.5 x 32.0 (traced), front leg carries the mag-release clevis; 0.3 seam where the guard insert meets the chassis is NOT drawn: one part with the chassis.
key_features: opening is a real see-through hole

parts.name: mag_release
parts.construction: Paddle in front of the trigger guard (real chassis pattern): drawn X 408.4-415.9, Z -71..-114. Built: pivot pin dia 3 at X 410.5, Z -78.0 (clevis in the guard's front leg); catch hook 24 above the pivot at Z -54 engaging the mag's rear-wall notch by 1.4 mm; finger pad 36 below the pivot; front face at rest 0.3 behind... see spec mag_release for the derived numbers (gap to the mag, press angle, hook travel). Push the pad forward = release.
key_features: declared shift of the paddle's front face behind the drawn edge (spec)
hook travel > engagement (S0 check)

parts.name: grip
parts.bevel: R 1.5-2.5, draft 1.5 deg, parting line on the mid-plane
parts.construction: Traced grip: rear strap 30.7 deg, front strap 24.9 deg from vertical (sheet; the brief said 'vertical', the sheet draws ~28 deg mean: the sheet wins, R13), fore-aft 54.3 at mid height, width 32 (unseen; polymer grip norm), bottom Z -166.4 with a flared base; finger-groove-free front; side panels with a moulded texture (normal: 0.6 pitch pebble) inside a geometric 0.5 border; one grip screw from below (hidden).
key_features: hand-fit H1 early (grip girth, trigger reach)

parts.name: barrel
parts.bevel: 0.3 flute edges; crown chamfer 45 deg x 1.0
parts.construction: Breech X 505.5 to crown X 1064.5 (559 mm, 22 in): heavy contour, 35.2 at the forend front tapering to 31.8 at the device (both side views; TOP inflates round parts +6-10 %); 6 straight flutes (3 visible per side as drawn), 6.0 wide x 2.0 deep with 1.0 radius bottoms, X 841-1036 (drawn flute span), run-outs as ball-end cutter exits (no knife edges, UD2); plain shank ahead of the flutes X 1036-1049.7; thread tenon dia 15.9 x 15 under the device; bore 7.8 dia >= 2 calibres deep with darkening.
key_features: flutes are geometry (study 3.2)
48 sides LOD0 (G3)
free-floated: >= 3.0 radial gap to the forend

parts.name: muzzle_device
parts.bevel: front chamfer 2.0 x 45 as drawn; rear collar step 0.5
parts.construction: Linear compensator (closed outer sleeve, no side ports drawn): X 1049.7-1100, OD 36.1 (side), rear collar step at X ~1052, front face with an exit bore 12 mm (3/4 view), internal baffle + forward vent ring behind the face (hidden; visible only down the exit). Threads on the tenon (hidden).
key_features: hide bone when a suppressor mounts (MuzzleSeat X 1049.7)
soot gradient at the exit

parts.name: magazine
parts.bevel: body bends inside R 1.0; cut edges 0.25; floorplate R 1.0
parts.construction: Straight double-stack 10-round box, vertical (sheet rake -0.9 / +1.3 deg: built 0.0), fore-aft 89.3, thickness 26.5 (unseen except 3/4; real .308 double stack 25.5-27.5), top at Z -11.0 under the bolt, well-entry Z -68.8, bottom Z -132.3 (exposed 63.5). Two pressed vertical ribs per side (as drawn in the 3/4, 0.8 proud), feed lips (single-feed, real pattern) with the top round modelled, follower; rear wall notch for the catch at Z -54; floorplate 2.0 thicker than the body with a 1.5 overhang front and back.
key_features: mag AO baked alone (rifle lesson)
insertion straight along -Z
spine and floorplate corner wear (R)

parts.name: bipod_mount
parts.construction: Dovetail clamp X 747.8-812.7 (drawn mount), Z -51.9..-39.7 under the forend band, with a throw-lever/ thumb screw on the left (unseen: plain screw head); swivel body extends rearward to the leg yoke around the hub axis (X 719.6, Z -61.8; hub dia 36.9 drawn); swivel (cant) about a bore-parallel axis at Z -48.0 with +-15 deg travel; the drawn knob below the hub (X 718-746, Z -85..-71) is the swivel-tension knob (dia 14, axis along X, knurled).
key_features: cant +-15 deg (bone bipod, rotate about X)
tension knob inside the leg gap (<= +-7.0 Y)

parts.name: bipod_legs
parts.construction: Outer tube OD 19.4 x wall 1.5 from the hub to the lock collar (X 719.6-896.4 folded), centres at Y +-19.5; each leg pivots on its own transverse pin through the yoke at the hub axis; detents 0 deg (folded forward, sheet pose) and +90 deg (deployed straight down) by a spring-loaded ball in a notched hub disk (2 notches); return spring inside the tube (hidden). Lock collar OD 28 x 18.8 with a push button on the outboard side.
key_features: legs move independently
hinge clearance 0.10-0.30 at the yoke
mount bottom 0.2 above the leg's top when folded

parts.name: bipod_leg_ext
parts.process_class: M-round (solid steel rod with notches) + P-round foot
parts.construction: Inner leg dia 12.7 telescoping in the outer tube; 5 detent notches at 19.0 mm (0, 19, 38, 57, 76 mm extension) engaged by the collar's spring button; spool-shaped rubber foot dia 37 x 29 long (sheet: 38.5 x 29) with a 0.5 waist and a centre screw on the end face (3/4 view).
key_features: ext travel 0..76 (5 detents)
feet abraded on the ground face (R)

parts.name: pins_fasteners
parts.construction: Only heads the sheet draws (GR: pad screws 3, butt knobs 2, chassis screws behind the knob and on the forend below slot 1, riser clamp; GL: its own set, read at form). Sizes: socket caps 4-5 mm thread class (heads 7-8.5), button heads 4.8 in rail slots, roll pins 3. Never written as 'M' + number.
key_features: count and position from the sheet only (study 3.2)
random slot clocking

cerakote_od_over_al.micro: ceramic paint orange-peel 0.2-0.5 mm (Detail16, normal only)
cerakote_od_over_al.wear: edge chips to a dark rim first, then bare aluminium (metallic 1, 0.91, rough 0.30-0.45) on the highest corners only; brief: 'light edge wear to dark grey'
cerakote_od_over_al.note: Metal From ORM on: OD is dark enough (study 5.9 brightness trap: safe)

anodized_black_al.wear: bright silver aluminium at edges (rare: rail edges, ring tops)

bare_steel_polished.where: bolt body and lugs, inner legs

rubber_black.sheet: butt pad reads 0.09 x the backdrop

materials.calibration: L5 against sheet crops under matched light before the first look (katana and SMG 'flat clay' lessons: rough-real finishes in the early looks, a physical light rig, not flat grey)

wear_logic: Painted aluminium chips at corners to a dark rim then metal (R); hand zones polish the paint (G: grip top, comb/riser left top, forend belly, bolt knob, safety arc); the bolt body is polished bare by sliding; the bipod feet, butt toe/heel and mag floorplate corners are abraded (R); dust in rail slots, forend slots and pocket corners (B); soot at the device exit and the port.

rulings.ruling: 3-lug, 60 deg throw, 88 mm stroke, bolt face X 505 at rest
rulings.why: the knob's rest angle (26 deg below horizontal) lifted 60 deg reaches 34 deg above horizontal: clears a 34 mm scope's eyepiece by > 20 mm; 88 mm clears a .308-class cartridge (71 mm) plus extraction; the port (84.6 drawn) is opened to 88 + 2

rulings.ruling: swept stem, spherical knob dia 24.8 (sheet), screw-on with a thread-relief groove
rulings.why: sheet size; real tactical knobs 20-25 mm; GR authority for X, TOP for Y

rulings.ruling: single-stage precision trigger, pivot above the blade, 6 deg pull; guard integral with the chassis
rulings.why: chassis rifles carry the guard in the chassis bottom; no seam drawn

rulings.ruling: 2-position tang rocker on the right, behind the bolt handle; FIRE forward (bind), SAFE 12 deg back
rulings.why: real pattern for this action class; not resolved on the sheet

rulings.ruling: paddle in front of the trigger guard, push forward; hook 24 above the pivot, pad 36 below
rulings.why: drawn where real chassis paddles sit; leverage chosen so a 3 mm pad press lifts the hook 2.0 mm (> 1.4 engagement)

rulings.ruling: straight 10-round double-stack steel box, vertical, 26.5 thick, two pressed ribs per side, polymer floorplate
rulings.why: exposed length 63.5 = a 10-round box; ribs drawn in the 3/4

rulings.ruling: 1913 base 15 slots flat; 34 mm two-piece rings (medium, centre 27.6 above the rail top), each with a recoil lug in a slot and two cross-bolt nuts on the left, 4 cap screws on top (2 per cap)
rulings.why: drawn ring height and tube; rings belong to the scope attachment

rulings.ruling: two steel posts dia 10, clamp lever on the left of the butt, travel -12.9..+12.0
rulings.why: drawn posts exposed 13.2 mm; GL draws a small lever

rulings.ruling: fixed butt; LOP by spacer plate (no bone); two clamp knobs on the right as drawn
rulings.why: no hinge or slide drawn; the brief's 'folding-style' look is kept as shape only (R6)

rulings.ruling: tension-swivel folding bipod on a dovetail clamp; independent legs on transverse pins at the hub (X 719.6, Z -61.8), detents 0 / +90 deg; telescoping inner legs 0..76 mm in 5 notches; swivel cant +-15 deg with the drawn rear knob as the tension knob
rulings.why: the drawn hub, knob, collar and spool feet are this pattern; the folded pose is the side views'

rulings.ruling: internal, left rear, not animated; no bone
rulings.why: not drawn; no visible function needed

rulings.ruling: linear compensator, closed sleeve, exit bore 12 mm
rulings.why: no ports drawn; front hole visible in the 3/4; brief: 'simple cylindrical muzzle cap'

rulings.ruling: 6 straight flutes 6.0 x 2.0, radius bottoms, ball-end run-outs, X 841-1036
rulings.why: 3 visible per side in the side views; run-outs avoid needle triangles (UD2)

rulings.ruling: 3 slots per side cut through the wall (original pattern, never named after a standard); bottom band = plain dovetail, no 1913 teeth
rulings.why: drawn without teeth; Rail_Bottom not offered (the bipod uses it)

rulings.ruling: 34 mm tube, 56 mm-class objective, elevation turret on top, windage on the right, parallax/side-focus on the left, magnification ring + throw lever at the eyepiece; rubber eyecup ring
rulings.why: TOP shows the left knob larger than the right turret; brief: rubber eye cup

unseen_plain: chassis underside except the mag well and dovetail
left side of the bolt (inside the receiver)
the butt's left-side QD cup interior (plain recess)
bipod clamp's left side (plain screw head)
magazine top and feed lips (real pattern, plain)

inconsistencies.what: TOP draws the bolt knob ~32 mm further back than GR (X 336 vs 368)
inconsistencies.handling: GR authority for X; TOP for the knob's Y only

inconsistencies.what: TOP right-side (image-down) edges sit 4-6 mm wider than the left edges (soft floor shadow at the right edge)
inconsistencies.handling: widths of symmetric parts = 2 x the left half-width; asymmetric parts read with a 5 mm bias correction

inconsistencies.what: TOP inflates round parts: device 38.1 vs 36.1 side, barrel 35.2 vs 31.8
the folded bipod feet in TOP span only ~60 mm, narrower than two 37 mm feet side by side allow
inconsistencies.handling: legs at Y +-19.5 with 37 mm feet (side-view size): TOP feet width 76, declared; TOP is not the bipod's authority

inconsistencies.what: mag rake: rear edge -0.9 deg, front edge +1.3 deg (GR); GL rear +3.4
the drawn mag-release front edge is 1.8 mm behind the mag's rear face, too close for a forward-push paddle
inconsistencies.handling: paddle front face moved rearward (declared in the spec)

inconsistencies.what: the 3/4 view shows the bipod folded (the study's sheet note said deployed)
inconsistencies.handling: deployed pose from the real pattern; the 3/4 is a second folded-pose check

fab_original_changes: chassis side pocket reshaped as two stepped pockets
forend slots as tapered lozenges of three lengths
riser plate with a scalloped front
butt cut-out with a reversed curve and a thumb notch
grip texture as a hex field with a thumb ledge
